heading: Today
text: A few patches of fog north, and any morning clouds, giving way to increasing sunshine.  Mostly sunny by afternoon.  Not quite so breezy and cool.  Highs in the low to mid 60s, a few upper 50s far north.  Winds light, mainly north to northeast up to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear north, with a few periods of high clouds far south.  Patches of river valley fog. Scattered frost in the cold spots.  Lows in the 30s to low 40s, some cold spots north near 30.  Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Areas of river valley fog, then mostly sunny and seasonably cool.  Highs in the low to mid 60s.  Winds light, mainly northeast less than 10 mph.
